part.head: Head
broken.nestFront: Front nest broken — no more swarm from it
broken.nestMid: Middle nest broken — no more swarm from it
broken.nestRear: Rear nest broken — no more swarm from it
broken.nests: All nests broken — no more swarm, fewer spouts
broken.dorsal: Dorsal fin broken — smaller tail slam
broken.tail: Tail broken — no tail slam, slower turns
broken.head: Head broken — no more clouds
warn.geyser: Don't fly straight — turn hard to the side
warn.sonar: Change altitude to clear the ring
warn.call: The swarm surrounds you — turn hard when they brace
active.sonar: The ring spreads — leave its altitude
inCloud: In the cloud — short lock range
bodyHit: Hit its body — you can't fly through
briefing: It slowly circles an oval over the bay. Huge HP, a long fight (when time runs out it crosses the bay and leaves)
You can't fly through its body or fins. Hitting them bounces you off and hurts. Shoot without getting too close

Attacks aimed at you: water columns (where you're heading plus 4 around it — turn hard to the side), song (a ring spreading at its altitude — go above or below), roll (fly past its side and a flipper swats you), call (the swarm surrounds you and charges — turn hard when they brace)
Spout above the back, tail slam right behind. The swarm comes out of 3 belly nests; break a nest to stop it. Shooting down the swarm also damages Albion
The head is a weak point (no more clouds). Breaking the tail stops the slam
